title: Noita
summary: Noita runs well on Apple Silicon through Pixel Port's free runtime. It is an OpenGL 3.0 game with no anti-cheat, so it needs no special configuration.

steps.title: Install Pixel Port
steps.body: Download Pixel Port and let it set up the free runtime on first launch.

steps.title: Add Noita
steps.body: Search the catalogue for Noita and hit Install & Play. Pixel Port fetches it and applies the verified recipe.

steps.title: Play
steps.body: Launch from your Library. Late-game pixel simulation is CPU-bound by design, so expect some frame dips in heavy scenes.

title: Meccha Chameleon
summary: Meccha Chameleon is verified end-to-end on Apple Silicon. It is an Unreal Engine 5 title that runs on Pixel Port's DXMT path with one click.

steps.title: Install Pixel Port
steps.body: Grab Pixel Port; the runtime installs itself on first run.

steps.title: Install & Play
steps.body: Find Meccha Chameleon in the catalogue and click Install & Play. The verified recipe handles the rest.

title: Manor Lords
summary: Manor Lords is an Unreal Engine 4.27 title that lists DirectX 12 but falls back to its D3D11 path under Pixel Port's DXMT layer, so it runs without a flag.

steps.title: Install Pixel Port
steps.body: Install Pixel Port and let the runtime set up.

steps.title: Install & Play
steps.body: Search for Manor Lords, install, and launch. FSR is recommended at 1080p on M1 and M2.
